race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 683 miles requires a practiced resupply plan built around confirmed course services and available commercial stops. Rehearse frequent carbohydrate intake on long rides, then scale the plan to intensity, sleep strategy, tolerance, and real food across the full event. Carry redundant fuel and avoid applying a short-event hourly target or fixed total-calorie estimate to a multi-day race.
race_overlay.altitude: Race Across Germany North–South with 24,606ft of climbing finishes high enough for reduced oxygen availability to affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Race Across Germany North–South rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.
